title: JetBlue Airways: Air Travel Consumer Report: May 2026 Operating Data
summary: DOT reports May 2026 on-time arrivals, cancellations, baggage, wheelchair and scooter handling, oversales, and complaint records. Phase 56E entity use: The annual operating-carrier rail remains separate from the later monthly on-time, baggage, wheelchair, complaint, and commitment denominators.
key_findings: May operating-carrier on-time percentages were 75.1 for American, 82.4 for Alaska, and 81.0 for JetBlue.
Entity layer: JetBlue Airways operating-carrier domestic scheduled service.
Compatibility boundary: Stable carrier identity; annual cancellation and monthly service measures remain separate.
why_it_matters: The record supports one or more layers of the second-cohort panel, driver-and-constraint dossier, and alternative-explanation test.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves a stable second-cohort entity identity.
Keeps attribution and the observation denominator visible.
Connects the same entity vertically across three evidence layers.
evidence_limits: A single month, separate service denominators, partner operations, and brand-level complaints cannot be combined into a score.
Official DOT compilation; carrier reporting is not an independent causal determination.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
